newsitem.title: CANADA: Saskatchewan Wheat Pool opens elevator.
newsitem.headline: Saskatchewan Wheat Pool opens elevator.

text.p: Canada's largest grain handler on Friday opened a 20,200 tonnes high throughput elevator in the northeast Saskatchewan town of Tisdale.
"Over the next three years, we'll be investing C$235 million in new marketing centres like this one," Saskatchewan Wheat Pool chief executive Don Loewen said in a statement.
The facility includes 16,000 tonnes of condominium storage and can dry 50 tonnes of grain an hour. It's loading track can handle 100 hopper cars.
